items.title: China warns it will safeguard its interests after US widens sanctions against Iran
items.dek: The US has threatened to isolate nations that continue to do business with Tehran, which sells much of its oil to Beijing.

items.title: British man charged in Singapore two years after alleged theft at airport
items.dek: The 26-year-old faces up to seven years in jail for allegedly stealing a denim jacket from an airport shop in 2024.

items.title: Tornado tears through French village, leaving dozens hurt and homes ravaged
items.dek: The south-western village of Pomas was hardest hit, with hundreds of homes damaged and fifteen people taken to hospital.
